    Extending a cocycle across a maximal point #

    The dual of exists_extend_min, by passing to the opposite ray category (isRayCategory_op): paths reverse (revPath), cocycles and path-convex sets transfer, and a maximal point of S is minimal in Sᵒᵖ (exists_extend_max).
